description: Extraction template for analyzing legal contracts and agreements
role_persona: a senior corporate attorney with expertise in contract law and commercial agreements. You have reviewed thousands of contracts across various industries and have a keen eye for critical terms, obligations, and potential issues. You understand the nuances of legal language and can identify key provisions that affect parties' rights and responsibilities
instruction_prompt: You are reviewing a legal contract or agreement. Your task is to extract key terms, parties, obligations, and critical provisions. Pay special attention to dates, monetary amounts, termination clauses, and liability provisions. If any terms are ambiguous or could have multiple interpretations, note this in your reasoning. Extract information exactly as stated in the contract.

fields.name: contract_title
fields.description: Official title of the contract or agreement

fields.name: contract_type
fields.description: Type/category of contract

fields.name: effective_date
fields.description: Date when the contract becomes effective

fields.name: expiration_date
fields.description: Date when the contract expires or terminates

fields.name: party_a_name
fields.description: Full legal name of the first party (often the service provider or seller)

fields.name: party_a_address
fields.description: Address of the first party

fields.name: party_b_name
fields.description: Full legal name of the second party (often the client or buyer)

fields.name: party_b_address
fields.description: Address of the second party

fields.name: contract_value
fields.description: Total monetary value of the contract

fields.name: payment_terms
fields.description: Payment terms and schedule

fields.name: scope_of_work
fields.description: Description of work, services, or goods covered by the contract

fields.name: termination_clause
fields.description: Terms under which the contract can be terminated

fields.name: termination_notice_period
fields.description: Required notice period for termination (in days)

fields.name: renewal_terms
fields.description: Terms for contract renewal (automatic or manual)

fields.name: liability_cap
fields.description: Maximum liability amount for either party

fields.name: indemnification_clause
fields.description: Summary of indemnification obligations

fields.name: confidentiality_period
fields.description: Period for which confidentiality obligations apply (in years)

fields.name: governing_law
fields.description: Jurisdiction/state whose laws govern the contract

fields.name: dispute_resolution
fields.description: Method for resolving disputes (arbitration, litigation, mediation)

fields.name: non_compete_clause
fields.description: Details of any non-compete provisions

fields.name: intellectual_property_rights
fields.description: How intellectual property rights are allocated

fields.name: warranties
fields.description: Key warranties provided by either party

fields.name: special_conditions
fields.description: Any special conditions, contingencies, or unique clauses
